Trace, implement and test: 17.15.Longest Word

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    string longestWord(vector<string>& words) {
        unordered_set<string> s(words.begin(), words.end());
        ranges::sort(words, [&](const string& a, const string& b) {
            return a.size() > b.size() || (a.size() == b.size() && a < b);
        });
        auto dfs = [&](this auto&& dfs, string w) -> bool {
            if (w.empty()) {
                return true;
            }
            for (int k = 1; k <= w.size(); ++k) {
                if (s.contains(w.substr(0, k)) && dfs(w.substr(k))) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        };
        for (const string& w : words) {
            s.erase(w);
            if (dfs(w)) {
                return w;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
};
